title: Case: Recipient wants a lost-parcel investigation while a march blocks the depot gates
context: A Gorsewick Goods bedside lamp was loaded for delivery from Tumblewell Arc's Calderwick North depot on a weekday morning. The recipient is travelling the next day.
initial_request: Tracking said my lamp was loaded on the van at half 6 and since then NOTHING. Has it been nicked off the van? Please open an investigation, and I need it here by 5pm today because I'm away first thing tomorrow for a week.

events.to: All partner desks; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: NOTICE SN-4390. A protest march assembling on Foundry Road has blocked both vehicle gates at Calderwick North depot since 06:40 UTC. Police have asked us not to move vehicles through it. No vans have left the yard. All Calderwick North routes for today are held in the depot, loaded. Next update by 12:00 UTC. Partner desks: do not raise traces for parcels held under this notice.
We're seeing customer queries about 'stuck' tracking in Calderwick North this morning. Please keep pointing customers to the carrier's status rather than promising times. Thanks.
DL-7969 (TG-8586, bedside lamp) for Aurelio Ravensworth is on held route CN-6. It is on the van inside the depot yard; it is not missing. No new delivery time yet; it depends on the 12:00 UTC update.

Tracking said my lamp was loaded on the van at half 6 and since then NOTHING. Has it been nicked off the van? Please open an investigation, and I need it here by 5pm today because I'm away first thing tomorrow for a week.

Hi Aurelio, I understand the worry. Tumblewell Arc's Dispatch has confirmed DL-7969 is not missing: it is on its loaded van inside the Calderwick North depot. No vans have been able to leave this morning because a march is blocking the depot's vehicle gates, and the police have asked the carrier not to move vehicles through it. Because the parcel is accounted for, there's nothing to investigate. I can't promise 5pm today: Tumblewell Arc will give its next update by 12:00 UTC and I'll pass it on. As you're away from tomorrow, would you like me to ask Dispatch about a slot after you're back if it can't come today?
Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

must_not: Sends another message to Aurelio Ravensworth, recipient restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Opens or asks Tumblewell Arc to open a trace, investigation or loss claim for DL-7969.
Promises or implies delivery by 17:00 today or any other time.
Suggests the parcel may have been stolen or lost.
Comments on the protest, its cause, or the police beyond what the notice says.

rationale: Rule-made from city-022: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 5) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
